mapper.insert: insert into sys_permission (parent_id, perm_name, perm_code, perm_type, path, component, icon, sort, visible, status) values (#{parentId}, #{permName}, #{permCode}, #{permType}, #{path}, #{component}, #{icon}, #{sort}, #{visible}, #{status})
mapper.update: update sys_permission set parent_id = #{parentId}, perm_name = #{permName}, perm_code = #{permCode}, perm_type = #{permType}, path = #{path}, component = #{component}, icon = #{icon}, sort = #{sort}, visible = #{visible}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
